selection_policy: Lifecycle maturity is recorded but never used as an exclusion criterion. A product is relevant when an explicit, proposed, or testable mapping path connects it to HPO-coded phenotypes, their provenance, downstream genomic interpretation, cohort discovery, or governed data use.

products.name: Human Exposome Data Standards
mapping_paths: Exposure concept -> ECTO or other governed exposure ontology
Exposure timeline -> phenotype onset and resolution context

products.name: Variation Representation Specification
products.hpo_use: stable variant identity for downstream phenotype-ranking evaluation

products.name: Categorical Variation Representation Specification
mapping_paths: Cat-VRS categorical variant -> VRS variation constraints

products.name: Variant Annotation Specification
mapping_paths: VA statement -> VRS or Cat-VRS subject

products.name: Sequence Annotation
mapping_paths: Sequence feature -> VRS location or molecular consequence
Sequence feature annotation -> VA evidence context

products.name: Pharmacogenomics Data Standardisation
mapping_paths: Medicine identity -> governed ATC, RxNorm or ChEBI context
products.hpo_use: drug-response phenotype disambiguation and adverse-event controls

products.name: Experiments Metadata Checklist
mapping_paths: Experiment metadata -> assay and provenance context for phenotype evidence
Experiment bias fields -> source-quality and confidence covariates
products.hpo_use: process provenance, bias and reproducibility analysis

products.name: Whole Genome Sequencing Quality Control Standards
mapping_paths: WGS quality metric -> reliability of variant evidence used in phenotype ranking
products.hpo_use: negative control and downstream evidence-quality stratification

products.name: Data Use Ontology
mapping_paths: DUO disease-specific restriction -> governed MONDO context
Beacon dataset access condition -> DUO term
products.hpo_use: machine-readable use eligibility; never copyright or consent authority

products.name: Data Passports
mapping_paths: Data Passport visa -> dataset access policy attribute
Data Passport -> GA4GH Passport identity and access flow
products.hpo_use: enforce access boundaries for restricted phenotype benchmarks

products.name: Beacon
mapping_paths: Beacon semantic phenotype filter -> HPO CURIE
Beacon genomic variation -> VRS-compatible representation where endpoint profile declares it
products.hpo_use: translated-query retrieval invariance and cohort-selection analysis

products.name: Phenopacket Store
products.hpo_use: gene and disease ranking, leakage testing and semantic perturbation
